gloss: waiting in line; waiting one's turn

definitions.gloss: waiting in line; waiting one's turn; queuing
definitions.explanation: The act of waiting for one's turn in a queue, whether at a restaurant, store, or other establishment.

examples.japanese: {順番|じゅんばん}{待|ま}ちをしている。
{順番|じゅんばん}{待|ま}ちの{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are a lot of people waiting in line.

examples.japanese: アプリで{順番|じゅんばん}{待|ま}ちの{登録|とうろく}ができるから、{店|みせ}で{並|なら}ばなくていい。
examples.english: You can register for a spot in line on the app, so you don't have to wait at the store.

notes:
{順番|じゅんばん}{待|ま}ち is common at popular restaurants and services.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {順番|じゅんばん}{待|ま}ちをする (to wait in line)
- {順番|じゅんばん}{待|ま}ちシステム (queue management system)
- {順番|じゅんばん}{待|ま}ち{時間|じかん} (waiting time)

MODERN SYSTEMS:
- Many restaurants use digital queue systems.
- You can often register via apps and receive notifications.
- {呼|よ}び{出|だ}し (calling your number/name)

RELATED WORDS:
- {行列|ぎょうれつ}: queue, line
- {整理券|せいりけん}: numbered ticket
